status: follow-up after the deep MI audit; exploratory; not part of the MB12 lock
decision: the model's top-1 action at the scored position (over all 15 actions); a flip is a change of top-1 between the intact and the edited run
edits: whole-context swap with all four identity inputs written back
flip_patching: on flip events: denoising (copy one site's intact activation into the edited run; restored if top-1 returns) and noising (copy one site's edited activation into the intact run; produced if top-1 changes); sites: each head, each MLP, each residual point, at the scored position; rates with match-resampled CIs; estimation half and all validation
decision_layer: logit lens (final LayerNorm and unembedding applied to resid_pre_0 and each resid_post): first layer from which the sign of Delta equals the final sign and stays; causal: on flip events, restore all attention and MLP outputs of layers 0..l at the scored position (embedding left edited); first l at which the intact top-1 returns
concentration_reading: the decision is called concentrated in one layer if one layer holds >= 60 per cent of events' decision layers
self_repair: mean-ablate one MLP at the scored position; total effect = change with everything downstream recomputed; direct effect = change with every later attention and MLP output frozen at the run's own unablated values; for Delta and the identity effect
redundancy: all 6 pairs of MLPs mean-ablated together at the scored position; interaction = joint change - sum of single changes (identity effect and Delta)
cross_model: SEL-4L seeds 100-104 and REF-2L, REF-4L (paths from config/reference_models.json): identity-removal and context-swap denoising profile at the scored position; C1 mean Delta and share > 0; C2 |partner change| - |random vector change|; C3 correlation with the player-only reference's habit change; C4 |I| - |I_floor| with the partner; estimation half
